what_it_does: Adelia is a custom AI processor chip built at the 4-nanometer scale (four billionths of a meter per transistor) designed specifically for running large language models like ChatGPT during inference—the phase where the model generates responses from user queries. Instead of using off-the-shelf graphics cards that consume large amounts of power, Adelia includes specialized circuits tuned for the exact math operations LLMs need: matrix multiplication (the core multiplication of vectors and grids of numbers), the attention mechanism (a model's ability to focus on relevant parts of input), and feed-forward layers (intermediate calculation stages). The chip combines an optimized memory hierarchy—fast on-chip storage plus external high-bandwidth memory—and supports mixed-precision computation, meaning it can use different number sizes for different operations to balance speed and accuracy. This design targets both cloud data centers and on-device inference scenarios where power and speed matter.
